calculation.description: At each date, negate each instrument's three-session return residual versus the tradable-universe median and divide by its trailing 20-session daily-return volatility. All inputs are lagged naturally at the decision timestamp and the signal artifact contains the reproducible date-symbol values.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-22 (0.06386), 2023-24 (0.05718), and 2025-26 (0.04275); uncertainty is material because the cross-section is 15 instruments.
validation.gate: absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840
